name: Yoshiyuki Ohmura
abstract_title: Constructive Approach to the Science of Consciousness
abstract: Current scientific theories of consciousness aim to explain which physical states or conditions give rise to phenomenal consciousness. A major challenge in scientifically addressing this question is that phenomenal consciousness is private and cannot be objectively observed, making direct verification impossible.
